scoring_justification: T1 recompute is feasible because the phonon frequencies are produced entirely by a well-defined analytical dynamical matrix; the checker reimplements the same matrix and compares every frequency branch within an absolute tolerance.

outputs.description: Phonon frequencies for copper along high-symmetry directions.
Phonon frequencies for silver along high-symmetry directions.

output_contract.notes: Force constants and all input parameters are provided in the instruction. No external datasets are needed; the checker recomputes frequencies from the same parameters.

hidden_assets.purpose: Force constants, lattice parameters and atomic masses for Cu and Ag to recompute phonon frequencies.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 (force constants) and Table 1 (lattice constants, masses).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the published tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values used in the paper's calculation; they serve as inputs to the recomputation, not as hidden targets.
